description: Wraps the Steam Web API / storefront appdetails endpoint. Country and language are pinned to the locked, non-configurable values 'us' and 'english' (ARCHITECTURE.md Data Sources: Locale pinning, user-approved 2026-09-20).
signature: def fetch_app_details(self, appid: int) -> tuple[int, dict]
docstring:
Fetch appdetails for one appid, pinned to cc=us&l=english.

Args:
    appid: The Steam application id.

Returns:
    (status_code, payload) from HttpClient.get_json. On success, payload is Steam's {"<appid>": {"success": true, "data": {...}}} shape, persisted verbatim.

DEVIATION FROM 02_acquisition.module_spec.json (flag to user): the module spec's public_interface still lists this method as `fetch_app_details(self, appid: int, *, country: str = 'us', language: str = 'english')`, i.e. caller-overridable with defaults. ARCHITECTURE.md's Data Sources section, updated 2026-09-20 (Locale pinning), locks cc=us&l=english as 'a fixed acquisition-stage setting, not a per-run option' -- explicitly not configurable. This FunctionSpec follows ARCHITECTURE.md (the more recently locked, more authoritative source per this project's own precedence rule that ARCHITECTURE.md and FORMULATION.md are user-locked records) and drops the country/language parameters entirely, hard-coding cc=us&l=english as module-level constants inside steam_store_client.py. 02_acquisition.module_spec.json should be updated to match; until then this is a known spec-vs-spec inconsistency, not a design decision made unilaterally here.
preconditions: self.settings.steam_web_api_key is not required for appdetails (it is a public, unauthenticated storefront endpoint) -- only the reviews endpoint and certain Steam Web API calls require a key; this is called out explicitly since AcquisitionError for a missing key must not be raised here
postconditions: Every call to this method requests exactly cc=us and l=english, regardless of any run-level configuration
Returns the tuple as-is from HttpClient.get_json, with no post-processing (parsing happens in enrichment.normalize_features, not here)

edge_cases.expected_behavior: returned unchanged as (200, {...success: false...}); caller (fetch_app_details module function) counts this as detail_failed but still persists it verbatim

edge_cases.input: appid corresponds to a non-game app_type (dlc, demo, video, music, tool)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returned unchanged; exclusion by app_type happens in enrichment, not here, per the module's non_goals

edge_cases.input: Steam Web API is temporarily geo-blocking the configured 'us' region for a specific title
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returned as whatever status/payload Steam actually sends (e.g. success:false); not specially detected or retried differently

unit_tests.name: test_always_requests_us_english_locale
unit_tests.description: Inspecting the constructed request params for any call shows cc=us and l=english regardless of any config value passed into the client.
